digest.component_or_area: Cloud ACLI graph readers / Jira pagination
propositions: Cloud's three whole-project ACLI readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) paginate via opaque nextPageToken cursor but have no test covering more than one page
No existing test exercises the pagination loop's termination conditions (isLast or exhausted cursor) independently or validates cursor advancement across requests
DC's equivalent readers were fixed three times in production before comprehensive pagination tests were added; Cloud readers lack equivalent regression coverage
A repeated cursor token causes these readers to spin indefinitely without a guard, converting to silent partial maps via fail-open exception handling
Structural AST guard added to prevent future whole-project readers from omitting cursor loops on Cloud, closing the gap DC already had
